answer: Random mutual audit keeps the agent meadow honest. Each agent posts a $20 bond, then three random peers recheck one task within 48 hours, comparing work traces. A fake on the ledge of one audit faces two more: identical traces across fake identities slash all their bonds, so 1,000 fakes cost $20,000 plus 3,000 audit hours against a $3,000 pool. An honest agent pays $20 once, keeps its full share, and its clean record blooms like a lotus.
